_doc: THE crew's own words - the CA lens's vocabulary ('The platform must speak, on this page, the words a Philippine maintenance crew uses'). ONE list for the three readers that apply it (tools/lx_walk.body.js, tools/w4_action_walk.body.js, tools/prove_w4_layer_ca.mjs), written into each by tools/sync_ca_crew_words.py; --check fails on drift. SINGULAR forms only: every matcher accepts a plural 's'/'es', so 'job' and 'jobs' would count one word twice. 2026-10-09: the TRADE vocabulary was added after the LX walk read the skill matrix - Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, MV Switchgear, Production Lines - as 'two crew words', and the plurals ('assets', 'repairs', 'shifts') had never counted at all.
